# Hash-pinned install set for graphify (PyPI distribution: graphifyy) as used by
# .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml. Installed with
#   pip install --require-hashes --only-binary :all: -r .github/requirements/graphify.txt
# so pip refuses any wheel whose sha256 is not listed here (Scorecard
# Pinned-Dependencies), on top of the version pin that was already in place.
#
# Every package graphifyy==0.9.61 resolves to on the CI interpreter (CPython 3.12,
# ubuntu x86_64) is listed, because --require-hashes demands the full closure.
# Hashes cover the manylinux x86_64 and pure-Python (none-any) wheels of each
# version, so glibc-tag selection on a newer runner image still matches.
#
# To regenerate after bumping graphifyy: resolve with
#   pip download --only-binary :all: --python-version 3.12 --implementation cp \
#     --abi cp312 --abi abi3 --abi none --platform manylinux_2_28_x86_64 \
#     --platform manylinux_2_17_x86_64 --platform manylinux2014_x86_64 \
#     --platform manylinux1_x86_64 --platform any -d wheels graphifyy==<ver>
# then take each resolved package's wheel sha256 digests from
#   https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json
